description: Read the FULL content of a single email by its UID (body, sender/recipients, date, attachment list, optional raw headers and text-attachment previews). By default the body is returned as clean Markdown in markdownContent and raw HTML is omitted so it never crosses the boundary; set bodyFormat to "html" for the legacy raw htmlContent, or "text" for plain text only. Use after imap_search_emails or imap_get_latest_emails gives you a uid. Body text is truncated to maxContentLength to protect the context window — raise it for long messages. To fetch attachment bytes, use imap_download_attachment.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

bodyFormat.description: How to return the body. "markdown" (default): clean Markdown via Turndown in markdownContent, raw htmlContent omitted so HTML never crosses the boundary. "text": plain text only in textContent. "html": legacy raw htmlContent. "auto": substantive text/plain if available, else Markdown.

includeAttachmentText.description: Include text attachment previews when available

includeHeaders.description: Include raw email headers (e.g. List-Unsubscribe, List-Unsubscribe-Post)

maxAttachmentTextChars.description: Maximum characters to return per text attachment

maxContentLength.description: Maximum characters to return for each body field (text/markdown/html)

name: imap_get_email
